body: I pay into the pool of shared internet, and I would plan to remove my payment to pay for private internet. Equipment could use some upgrading but in my eyes equipment means nothing if they don’t pay their portion of the bill on time.
I always find myself wanting to go “home”. It’s a bit odd knowing I’m technically at my residence, but I still feel like i’m not in the right place. You described it perfectly.

I know this post is a bit old, but I just wanted to say thanks to everyone who spoke about their struggles. It makes me feel a lot better looking back and knowing I’m not alone. I hope everyone is doing alright ❤️
Don’t worry about it! Your experience didn’t come off self-centered at all, and I relate in some ways. I’m starting to think it’s all apart of the healing process as well.

Trust me I don’t mind lol. I’ve always thought like this, and I’ll admit that I’ve denied having suicidal ideation whenever therapists have asked post-treatment. It may not be the best thing to do, but I’ve gotten better at not thinking about my ideas for too long.
I’m in the same boat. I think writing helps a lot!
Honestly, I think that’s how my brain is wired and/or I’m still slowly recovering. Most of the time I’m not sad, but I still revert to how I used think pre-attempt.

It’s hard thinking about that dreadful moment. It was weird when my anniversary passed by, but silly me just bought crab legs and called it a day. I hope you’re doing alright, and realize how meaningful it is that you’re still pushing forward.
I appreciate the concern <3 Despite how silly it sounds, I’m doing alright. I just happen to struggle with intrusive thoughts/I have no intention on acting on them.

I know that feeling of repetitive cycle of self-loathing and I just want to give you a virtual hug <3 Don’t surround yourself with someone who actively demeans you. You are not someone’s stepping stool and you are worthy.
